opening.argument: The concrete offer ties “unlimited earning” to a 2000 PKR payment for each referral and expressly seeks 20 networkers, showing that income depends on building a multi-person network. The description also invites interested members to make contact, directing viewers toward participation rather than presenting a warning or investigation. Read alongside the motivational speaker footage and the Forsage title, the presentation is promotional in character. The central mechanism is therefore recruitment through referral payments and a tiered network structure, not an independently described earning opportunity. These stated features establish the basis for treating the offer as a scam mechanism without claiming specific losses or a completed outcome.
